hook: Three crypto wallets were secretly stealing your keys — plus 4 more

items.claim: Three CryptoBilis‑sold Trezor Safe 5 wallets had implants that stole recovery phrases.
Microsoft released nearly 1,100 patches this month, including 63 critical fixes.
Google’s Chrome update 157 added 83 security fixes, five critical.
Check Point says a zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑123039) is exploiting root access on dozens.
Microsoft’s Patch Tuesday fixed an Outlook flaw (CVE‑2026‑124194) already being exploited.

caption: Hardware implants can silently steal your crypto, while software patches keep browsers and email safe. This week’s fixes range from Chrome’s 83 fixes to a zero‑day root exploit. Which threat worried you more, the wallet implants or the Outlook flaw?
alt_text: Slide 1 says three CryptoBilis‑sold Trezor Safe 5 wallets had implants that stole recovery phrases; slide 2 says Microsoft released nearly 1,100 patches this month, 63 critical; slide 3 says Google’s Chrome 157 update added 83 security fixes, five critical; slide 4 says Check Point says a zero‑day (CVE‑2026‑123039) is exploiting root access on dozens; slide 5 says Microsoft’s Patch Tuesday fixed an Outlook flaw (CVE‑2026‑124194) already being exploited.

es.hook: Tres carteras de criptomonedas estaban robando secretamente tus claves — y 4 más
items: Tres carteras Trezor Safe 5 vendidas por CryptoBilis tenían implantes que robaban frases de recuperación.
Microsoft lanzó casi 1 100 parches este mes, incluidos 63 parches críticos.
La actualización 157 de Chrome de Google añadió 83 correcciones de seguridad, cinco de ellas críticas.
Check Point dice que una vulnerabilidad cero‑day (CVE‑2026‑123039) está explotando acceso de root en decenas de sistemas.
El Patch Tuesday de Microsoft corrigió una falla de Outlook (CVE‑2026‑124194) que ya estaba siendo explotada.
